item.title: My First Hugo Site
item.description:
During my early years of building websites, Jekyll was the first static site generator that I got to know and I believe it’s the most popular one among developers at the time, partly because it’s also the default ‘engine’ for GitHub Pages.

Even though I did not use Jekyll to create websites for clients, I’d still spend time watching YouTube tutorials to build my own personal sites which never got published. And the reason is that Jekyll, just like Hugo, is designed specifically for content-focused or blogging sites.
